# Nested Properties

Obsidian's Properties panel flattens nested frontmatter objects into raw text. This plugin shows them as a tree, with keys and values lined up in two columns:

```yaml
grant:
  call: Horizon Health 2026
  budget:
    total: 450000
    ours: 180000
```

Leaf values can be edited in place, and the rest of the frontmatter is left exactly as it was.
